rule: A new row needs a page dated 2025–2026 that names it and carries a copied sentence (scripts/library-check.cjs), then a map check on Baidu Maps (Google Maps knows little of mainland China): ok only when the map shows the place at the page's address, not closed, with a review from the last six months. Prices marked 'Baidu Maps' are the map's average spend per person.
agents: four Haiku agents, five web searches each; 37 rows offered, 17 passed library-check.cjs, 11 went in
